name: Founder OS
tagline: Stand up the company, then run it from one desk.
rationale: A solo founder is a whole company wearing one hat. This bundle spreads the hat: one bot stands up the operating files, one sets the agenda and directs the rest, one runs the weekly GTM and onboarding grind, one watches the competition, and one keeps the books. It's an operating system for a company of one, with you making the calls.

members.name: Foundry
members.reason: Interviews you about a new venture and writes the operating files it will run on.

members.name: CEO
members.reason: A virtual CEO that sets the agenda and directs your other bots, so the roster actually pulls together.

members.name: SaaSbot
members.reason: A weekday operator that runs GTM, outbound, QA and onboarding across the week.

members.name: Competitor Watching
members.reason: Snapshots you against three to eight competitors on pricing, features and messaging, and alerts only on material change.

members.name: Receipt Scanner / Expense Tracking
members.reason: Forward a receipt and it becomes a row in your expense sheet, the finance admin nobody wants to do.
